devdoc.details: This is a basic implementation using a mapping for address => bool.This contract does not check if the address is a contract or not.This contract is a modified version of https://github.com/Idle-Finance/idle-staking/blob/master/contracts/smartWalletChecker/SmartWalletChecker.sol

check(address).details: This method will be called by the VotingEscrow contract.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

toggleAddress(address,bool).details: only callable by owner.This does not check if the address is actually a smart contract or not.

toggleIsOpen(bool).details: only callable by owner.Once isOpen is set to true, it cannot be set to false without locking users in so be careful.

params._open: Wheter to allow or not anyone

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

toggleIsOpen(bool).notice: Allow any non EOA to interact with stkIDLE contract.
